title: GiST for Geospatial Preview
summary: Preview how PostGIS uses GiST for containment and distance predicates, and where the extension boundary begins.
learning_objectives: Identify when geospatial predicates justify PostGIS rather than latitude and longitude columns alone.
Explain how GiST supports geometry and geography predicates such as ST_Contains and ST_DWithin.
State the PostGIS-not-yet boundary when the core lab only needs display coordinates or range indexing.
reflection_prompts: Which spatial predicate makes this more than display coordinates?
What operational evidence would justify enabling the PostGIS profile?
